method_note: Protocol: RAW retrieval layer only — dense/BM25/RRF candidates, top-10 (served) and top-50 (failure taxonomy), rerank OFF. Two cautions. (1) The 40 expansion questions passed the answerability gate (a relevant chunk sits in the production retriever's top-10), so the full-55 numbers describe retrieval on validated-answerable questions, not a stress test. (2) The original 15 questions read recall@5 0.90 at this raw layer — the committed 'sealed recall@5 0.600' is a DIFFERENT layer: the operational fetch of the sealed generation pass (reranked, top-3 citations). The two are not comparable; the raw layer says retrieval per se rarely fails on these questions, so the sealed loss concentrates at the rerank/top-k operating point — measured with the champion config by the generation pass, which is where the per-question failure taxonomy completes.

generation_pass_failures.headline: 9 of 11 failures retrieved the relevant article at rank 1 (fetched AND cited) yet kept unsupported claims - the bottleneck is generation grounding, not retrieval; 1 top-k demotion (relevant at rank 7, outside the fetch; the harness verdict reads retrieval-miss); 0 raw retrieval misses in the top-50; 1 abstention format slip among the 13 unanswerable (refusal accuracy 12/13 = 0.923).

examples.topk_demotion: How does C4 carbon fixation concentrate carbon dioxide for t (top_rank 7)
examples.generation_unsupported_retrieval_perfect: Where is geothermal power used in the United Kingdom?
examples.abstention_format_slip: What is the intended cruise speed of the Boom Overture supersonic airliner?
